verdict.line: You lose if Riven catches you without Remove Scurvy up and chains Ki Burst into Broken Wings, especially the moment she hits level 6 Blade of the Exile; you win every exchange where you poke from Parrrley range and make her walk through poison to reach you.

brief.thesis: Riven has to close distance with Valor (250 range) or Broken Wings (275 range) before any of her damage lands, while Parrrley reaches 625 range and Grog-Soaked Blade ticks poison on every auto she eats on approach. The matchup's 53.3% head-to-head win rate over 1649 games reflects that gap: Gangplank's threat is passive and ranged, Riven's is burst and committed, so the lane is decided by whether you have Remove Scurvy ready to answer her stun.

theirWindow.what: She gains Blade of the Exile (R) - bonus AD, extended range, and a one-time ranged Wind Slash - then looks to chain Q (Broken Wings) into W (Ki Burst) for a stun-locked all-in. Hold Remove Scurvy (W) in reserve and don't extend trades into melee range here.

yourWindow.what: Valor is her only dash to close distance or shield through incoming damage; with it down (6-10s depending on rank) she can't escape your poke or block the poison. Walk up and fire Parrrley (Q, 5s cooldown) freely.

start.why: 53.3% win rate over 1465 games and the highest pick rate (74.7%) — the extra sustain lets you eat her dash-in trades without losing the poke war.

boots.why: 53.9% win rate over 1103 games (62.7% pick) — flat physical damage reduction blunts her empowered Runic Blade autos during an all-in.

core.why: Mana sustain to spam Parrrley every 5 seconds without running dry
Execute threshold and lethality punish her for diving in low

runes.keystoneWhy: The DoT proc stacks with Grog-Soaked Blade poison on every poke, so even when she dashes out of range with Valor she keeps taking damage.

summoners.why: 52.5% win rate at 89.9% pick rate — Ignite closes out poke trades and cuts through any healing she picks up, Flash keeps you safe from a committed Broken Wings engage.

playing.title: Poke from Parrrley range
playing.detail: Fire Q (Parrrley, 625 range) every time she steps forward instead of trading in melee — she has no answer to it until she's already closed the gap.

playing.title: Save Remove Scurvy for her stun
playing.detail: Hold W until she commits Ki Burst; it clears the stun and heals you, which single-handedly invalidates her combo if timed right.

playing.title: Punish Valor cooldown
playing.detail: Track her E (Valor, 6-10s depending on rank) — when it's down she has no dash to escape poke or block damage, so press the window.

playing.title: Respect level 6 all-in
playing.detail: The moment she hits R (Blade of the Exile), she gets bonus AD, range, and a ranged Wind Slash — don't extend fights here, let poison do the work from range instead.

playing.title: Read her Runic Blade charges
playing.detail: Her passive charges on ability use and empowers her next auto; a glowing weapon means she's one auto from a bigger hit, so don't stand in auto range unnecessarily.

playing.title: Use Raise Morale to disengage
playing.detail: E (Raise Morale, 20s cooldown) gives you movement speed — use it to break off a trade or kite away from a Broken Wings knockback setup.

playing.title: Zone or finish with Cannon Barrage
playing.detail: Save R for punishing an overextended all-in attempt; the slow plus damage-over-time can finish a Riven who commits past her Valor and Broken Wings cooldowns.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample figures are measured OP.GG data from current-patch games; the mechanical reasoning about cooldowns, ranges, and trade windows is my own tactical read, not something OP.GG tracks.

stats.opponentTip: Keep an eye out on Riven’s Conqueror stacks while contesting lane. Avoid fighting her in prolonged combat when Riven learns (R) as she will try to get a kill.
